extraction_note: One of the ~10 reclass_reason cases named in README §1 bullet 3. Doc gives a clear vocabulary mapping: annotation_plans.md's L5a claim was found internally self-contradictory -- it asserted the fix was a missing return-capture (bug-awareness-only, L5a-shaped) while, in the same breath, admitting 'returnExpression == _savingsAccount.transfer(...)' cannot be written because the grammar disallows function calls in intentValue -- L5a requires the post-condition be expressible with only bug-awareness missing, which this contradicts. Correct value (the shares actually returned by the state-modifying transfer()/transferFrom() call) is never captured into any local (that omission is the bug itself), and @IReturn cannot rescue it because @IReturn is view/pure-only and transfer() is state-modifying -- so the debug-annotation channel is structurally closed too, not just the intent grammar. Doc assigns axis alpha (function-call-result needed, no scope binding, and no debug-channel workaround given the state-modifying-call restriction), matching csv's l4a_axis=alpha. Twinned by the doc with Case 7 (59_H_05) as a 'wrapper return misrouting' family -- Case 7 is a dual-use value collapse, Case 9 (this case) is a returned-value drop (parameter substituted for the real interface-call result).
